copy.name: How to pick a random name with a spinning wheel
copy.blurb: Type one name per line and press Spin. The winner is drawn with Web Crypto, so every line has the same chance; tick remove-winner to draw a whole order without repeats.
copy.title: How to pick a random name with a spinning wheel
copy.lead: You need a fair, visible way to choose: who presents first, which restaurant tonight, who wins a small giveaway. You will put the names on a wheel, spin it and keep a record. Nothing leaves this tab.
copy.result: A winner on screen, a history of every draw, and, if you like, the full order with each name drawn once.
copy.note: Open Spin the wheel and paste your list. Share your screen while you spin so everyone sees the same draw. Nothing is uploaded.
copy.s1b: Each line is one slice. The winner is picked with Web Crypto before the wheel moves, then the wheel turns until that slice stops under the pointer. Every line has the same chance: with 6 names, 1 in 6.
copy.s2t: Open Spin the wheel on cv.cm
copy.s2b: Six sample food choices are on the wheel. The list sits on the left, one entry per line. Nothing is uploaded.
copy.s3b: Replace the list with your names or options, one per line, up to 100. Empty lines are ignored. Repeat a line to give it a bigger chance: a name on two lines out of six has 2 in 6.
copy.s4b: The wheel slows down and shows “Winner: …”. The name is added to History, and “Copy winner” puts it on the clipboard.
copy.s5b: Tick “Remove the winner after each spin”. Each winner leaves the list, so four spins with five names set the first four places and the name left over goes last. History keeps the order.
copy.s6b: Shuffle mixes the slices and Sort puts them in alphabetical order. Neither changes the odds; they only change where each name sits on the wheel.
copy.diagram1: Each line is one slice; the winner is drawn with Web Crypto before the wheel spins.
copy.diagram2: With remove-winner on, four spins over five names give the order; the last name left goes fifth.

faq.q1: Is there a free random name picker wheel?
faq.a1: Yes. cv.cm's wheel runs in your browser and draws with Web Crypto. Nothing is uploaded.
faq.a2: Yes. The winner is chosen at random before the animation, and every line has the same chance.
faq.q3: How do I stop the same name winning twice?
faq.a3: Tick “Remove the winner after each spin”; each winner leaves the list.
faq.q4: Can I give one option more chance?
faq.a4: Add it on more lines. Two lines out of six give it a 2 in 6 chance.
faq.q5: How many names can I add?
faq.a5: Up to 100 lines of up to 40 characters; long names are shortened on the wheel itself.

copy.name: How to calculate the mean, median, mode and standard deviation
copy.blurb: Mean = sum ÷ count, median = the middle value, mode = the most frequent. For 12 15 15 18 20 22 30 the mean is 18.86, the median 18, the mode 15 and the sample standard deviation 5.96.
copy.title: How to calculate the mean, median, mode and standard deviation
copy.lead: You have a list of numbers — test scores, prices, times — and want to know the typical value and how spread out they are. You will paste the list and read every common statistic at once. Nothing leaves this tab.
copy.result: Mean, median, mode, count, sum, minimum, maximum, range, sample and population standard deviation and variance, and geometric mean.
copy.note: Open the average calculator with your numbers ready to paste, for example a column from a spreadsheet. Nothing is uploaded.
copy.s1b: Mean: add the numbers and divide by how many there are. Median: sort them and take the middle one (or the mean of the middle two). Mode: the value that appears most often. For 12 15 15 18 20 22 30: sum 132 ÷ 7 = 18.86, median 18, mode 15.
copy.s2b: Seven sample numbers are filled in and the results sit on the right. Nothing is uploaded.
copy.s3b: Separate them with spaces, new lines or semicolons. Under Decimal mark pick 3.5 or 3,5 to match how you write decimals. Anything that is not a number is listed as skipped.
copy.s4b: Use the mean for evenly spread data. Use the median when a few values are extreme: incomes of 30, 32, 35 and 400 have a mean of 124.25 but a median of 33.5. Use the mode for the most common answer.
copy.s5b: Standard deviation shows how far values sit from the mean. Use the sample value (n − 1) when the numbers are a sample of a larger group and the population value (n) when they are the whole group. Range is maximum − minimum.
copy.s6b: Copy puts every line on the clipboard, ready for a report. Clear empties the list for the next set.
copy.diagram1: Mean = sum ÷ count; median = middle value; mode = most frequent.
copy.diagram2: 30, 32, 35, 400: mean 124.25, median 33.5 — the median resists outliers.

faq.q1: Is there a free mean, median and mode calculator?
faq.a1: Yes. cv.cm calculates them in your browser with standard deviation and variance. Nothing is uploaded.
faq.q2: When should I use the median instead of the mean?
faq.a2: When a few values are much larger or smaller than the rest, such as incomes or house prices.
faq.q3: What is the difference between sample and population standard deviation?
faq.a3: Sample divides by n − 1 and is used when the data is a sample; population divides by n and is used for the whole group.
faq.a4: Then there is no mode; the tool shows None.
faq.q5: Can I paste numbers with decimal commas?
faq.a5: Yes. Set Decimal mark to 3,5; then commas are decimals and spaces, new lines or semicolons separate numbers.

copy.name: How to practise with an online metronome
copy.blurb: Set the tempo in BPM or tap it from a recording, pick beats per bar and clicks per beat, then speed up by about 5 BPM each time a passage is clean. Runs in your browser.
copy.title: How to practise with an online metronome
copy.lead: You want steady timing on an instrument, in a dance routine or while drumming. You will set a tempo, match the bar to your music and raise the speed step by step. The clicks are made in your browser; nothing is uploaded.
copy.result: A steady click at your tempo with the first beat of each bar accented, and a plan to reach your target speed.
copy.note: Open the metronome and use headphones if the room is loud. Phones on silent may mute the clicks. Nothing is uploaded.
copy.s1t: Know BPM and beats per bar
copy.s1b: BPM is beats per minute: 60 BPM is one beat per second, 120 BPM two. Beats per bar is the top number of the time signature: 4 for most pop (4/4), 3 for a waltz (3/4), 6 for many jigs (6/8).
copy.s2b: It starts at 120 BPM in 4 beats per bar. Press Start to hear it; the dots follow each beat and the first beat sounds higher.
copy.s3b: Type a BPM, drag the slider or use −5, −1, +1 and +5. To match a song, press Tap on four or more beats; the BPM follows your taps. The tempo name (Andante, Allegro…) is shown under the number.
copy.s4b: Pick Beats per bar, and under Clicks per beat choose eighth notes, triplets or sixteenth notes to hear the beat split. Untick “Accent the first beat” for an even click.
copy.s5b: Start where you can play a passage cleanly three times in a row, for example 80 BPM. Then add 5 BPM and repeat. When it breaks down, drop back 10 BPM.
copy.s6b: Press Stop and write down the last clean BPM, so the next session starts there.
copy.diagram1: BPM = beats per minute; beats per bar = top number of the time signature.
copy.diagram2: 80 → 85 → 90 BPM: speed up by 5 after three clean runs.

faq.q1: Is there a free online metronome?
faq.a1: Yes. cv.cm's metronome runs in your browser from 20 to 300 BPM. Nothing is uploaded.
faq.q2: How do I find the BPM of a song?
faq.a2: Press Tap on the beat four or more times; the BPM follows the average of your taps.
faq.q3: What BPM should I start at?
faq.a3: The fastest tempo at which you can play the passage cleanly three times in a row.
faq.a4: Pick 3 or 6 under Beats per bar; the first beat is accented.
faq.a5: Check the volume slider, the device volume and the silent switch. Some browsers pause audio in background tabs.

copy.name: How to test every key on your keyboard online
copy.blurb: Click the keyboard map and press every key: working keys turn pink. Check key, code and keyCode, and hold several keys to test rollover. Nothing is recorded.
copy.title: How to test every key on your keyboard online
copy.lead: A key feels dead, repeats or you just bought a keyboard and want to check it. You will press every key on a full keyboard map, read what the browser receives and test how many keys register together. Nothing leaves this tab.
copy.result: A map with every working key marked, the last key's key, code and keyCode, and the most keys held at once.
copy.note: Open the keyboard tester and click the keyboard picture before pressing keys. Click elsewhere to stop. Nothing is recorded or uploaded.
copy.s1t: Know what the browser can see
copy.s1b: Each key press sends key (the character, like a), code (the physical key, like KeyA) and the older keyCode (65). Fn and some media or system keys never reach the browser, so they cannot be tested here.
copy.s2b: A full keyboard map appears with function keys, navigation keys and the number pad. Nothing is recorded.
copy.s3t: Click the map and press every key
copy.s3b: Each working key turns pink; the key you hold turns dark. Go row by row so you do not miss any. Tab moves on after you have tested it once.
copy.s4b: Last key shows key, code, keyCode, location (left, right or numpad) and modifiers. Left and right Shift have different codes, so you can tell them apart.
copy.s5b: Hold several keys together, for example W, A, S and Shift. The counter shows the most held at once. If a key does not light up while others are down, the keyboard has a rollover limit.
copy.s6b: Keys still white after a full pass did not register: try them in a text field too. A key that stays dark is stuck. Reset clears the map for another pass.
copy.diagram1: key = character, code = physical key, keyCode = legacy number.
copy.diagram2: Hold W + A + S + Shift: most at once shows the rollover.

faq.q1: Is there a free online keyboard tester?
faq.a1: Yes. cv.cm shows a full keyboard map in your browser. Nothing is recorded.
faq.q2: Why does a key not light up?
faq.a2: It may be broken, or it may be Fn or a system key that never reaches the browser.
faq.a3: How many keys the keyboard reports at once. Hold several keys and read the most held at once.
faq.q4: What is the difference between key and code?
faq.a4: key is the character produced and depends on the layout; code is the physical key position.
faq.a5: Yes. Ignore the number pad if your laptop has none.

copy.name: How to find your star sign and Chinese zodiac animal
copy.blurb: Your star sign depends on the day and month; your Chinese zodiac animal on the lunar year, which starts on Lunar New Year between 21 January and 20 February. 15 August 1995 is Leo and the wood Pig.
copy.title: How to find your star sign and Chinese zodiac animal
copy.lead: You want your star sign, your Chinese zodiac animal, or both. You will enter a birthday and read both, with the Lunar New Year date checked for early-year birthdays. Nothing leaves this tab.
copy.result: Star sign with its dates and element, Chinese zodiac animal, year element with yin or yang, and the year name.
copy.note: Open the zodiac sign finder with the birth date in day, month and year. Nothing is uploaded.
copy.s1b: The star sign follows the Sun through 12 signs, so it depends only on the day and month: Leo runs from 23 July to 22 August. The Chinese zodiac gives each lunar year one of 12 animals, so it depends on the year.
copy.s2t: Open Zodiac sign finder on cv.cm
copy.s2b: A sample birthday, 15 August 1995, shows Leo and the wood Pig. Below are tables of sign dates and animal years. Nothing is uploaded.
copy.s3b: Pick the date. Star sign, dates, element, Chinese zodiac, year element and year name update at once.
copy.s4b: The lunar year starts on Lunar New Year, between 21 January and 20 February. 9 February 2024 is still the Rabbit, because the Dragon year began on 10 February. The tool says when a birthday falls before it.
copy.s5t: Read the element and year name
copy.s5b: Each year has an element (wood, fire, earth, metal or water) and is yin or yang; with the animal they form a 60-year cycle such as 甲辰 (wood Dragon) for 2024.
copy.s6b: If you were born on the first or last day of a sign, it can move by a day in some years. Copy puts all the results on the clipboard.
copy.diagram1: Star sign = day and month; Chinese zodiac = lunar year.
copy.diagram2: 9 Feb 2024 = Rabbit; 10 Feb 2024 = Dragon (Lunar New Year).

faq.q1: How do I find my zodiac sign free?
faq.a1: Enter your birthday on cv.cm; it shows the star sign and Chinese zodiac in your browser. Nothing is uploaded.
faq.q2: Why is my Chinese zodiac animal different from the year I was born?
faq.a2: If you were born before Lunar New Year, you belong to the previous lunar year.
faq.a3: Leo, which runs from 23 July to 22 August.
faq.q4: What is the Chinese zodiac for 2024?
faq.a4: The wood Dragon (甲辰), from 10 February 2024 to 28 January 2025.
faq.q5: Why do sign dates vary between sites?
faq.a5: The Sun enters each sign at a slightly different time each year, so the first day can move by one.
